template.name: Breakthrough Volatility
template.entry_long: high - low > {p0} * (donchian_high(high, {p0}) - donchian_low(low, {p1})) / {p2} and close > open
template.exit_long: high - low > {p1} * (donchian_high(high, 2) - donchian_low(low, 2)) / 2 and close < open
template.notes: The documented range-expansion filter becomes a current range exceeding the two-bar mean range by at most 5 percent, standing in for the two-pip upper band, and the candle colour sets direction. StopLossPoints/TakeProfitPoints/TrailingStopPoints and the reverse-on-loss sequence with MaxReverseOrders are point and position-management fields.
